record_type_quote: In 2015, as part of the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology, we published a Registered Report (Fung et al., 2015), that described how we intended to replicate selected experiments from the paper "Inhibition of BET recruitment to chromatin as an effective treatment for MLL-fusion leukaemia" (Dawson et al., 2011). Here, we report the results of those experiments.

targets.outcome_quote: Further, I-BET151 resulted in a statistically significant decrease in BCL2 expression in MV4;11 cells, but not in K-562 cells; again this is similar to the findings reported in the original study (Figure 3D; Dawson et al., 2011). We did not find a statistically significant difference in survival when testing I-BET151 efficacy in a disseminated xenograft MLL mouse model, whereas the original study reported increased survival in I-BET151 treated mice compared to vehicle control (Figure 4B,D; Dawson et al., 2011).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly compare agreeing growth inhibition and BCL2 results with the absence of the original significant survival benefit; disease-burden direction also agrees. These are multiple comparisons with differing results, without an overall verdict superseding them. Discussed protocol limitations do not amount to an overall uninformative verdict.

reasoning: Completed new biological experiments retest the single Dawson 2011 article. The earlier registered report is the plan for this replication rather than its target; other BET studies are background. Full article, authors, DOI and references verified in Europe PMC XML.
